preconditions: The user must already have a registered account
workflow: User must not be able to log in if the account is locked
User adds a product to the cart
User opens the cart and removes the selected item
User opens the open menu and click on logout
requirement_analysis.expected_result: User must be on the login page

business_rules: The user must already have a registered account
User must not be able to log in if the account is locked
Username field must not be submittable while empty
Password field must not be submittable while empty
A locked-out or disabled account must be rejected with a clear error message
Password characters must be masked on screen

scenarios.title: Login: complete the flow with fully valid data
Login: attempt the flow with an invalid or locked account
Login: attempt the flow with a required field left empty
Login: attempt the flow with exactly one item / minimum valid input
Login: reach the same goal via a different valid path
Login: attempt the flow while the app returns an error page

test_cases.title: Login: complete the flow with fully valid data
steps: Add a product to the cart
Proceed to checkout and fill in the required details
test_cases.expected_result: The order completes and a confirmation message is shown

test_cases.title: Login: attempt the flow with an invalid or locked account
steps: Enter credentials that are invalid or belong to a locked account
test_cases.expected_result: Login is rejected and a clear error message is shown

test_cases.title: Login: attempt the flow with a required field left empty
steps: Leave a required field (username or password) empty
test_cases.expected_result: The action is blocked and a 'field required' error message is shown

test_cases.title: Login: attempt the flow with exactly one item / minimum valid input
steps: Add exactly one product to the cart
test_cases.expected_result: The cart shows exactly one item with the correct count badge

test_cases.title: Login: reach the same goal via a different valid path
steps: Reach the cart via a different valid navigation path
test_cases.expected_result: The same cart contents are reachable either way

test_cases.title: Login: attempt the flow while the app returns an error page
steps: Trigger a condition that would normally cause a server or network error
test_cases.expected_result: The app shows a graceful error message instead of crashing

rag_matches.title: Login: complete the flow with fully valid data
